text_block_list.name: C.B. & Ace
text_block_list.text:
Daaaaaaaaaah!!
Uooooooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace crosses the finish line!
Katsuragi Ace has raced through with absolute pride!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace delivered a truly
magnificent, jaw-dropping race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah... damn it! They took it!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, YESSS!!
Did you see that, everyone?! Did you see that...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Where I come from doesn't matter! Being from the boonies doesn't matter!! I'll just smash right through common sense!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Follow me—
Follow Katsuragi Ace, the Rebel!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!
Katsuragi Ace is so cool~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised, but it was awesome!
That was the greatest race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, CB was strong too, she really stood out!
Both of you were amazing.
They say Rudolf is coming, but CB's not done—

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: The only reason CB stood out was because Rudolf didn't run today.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: ? That might be true, but...

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, yeah.
Sorry, you're right...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"CB!
What race are you running next?!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Always jumping the gun, Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Just hurry up and tell me!
I'm definitely running with you!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Let's see.
Actually, I've already decided. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: You know full well. It's the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Is that Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She told me she wants to race.
Ace, the current Rudolf is strong.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Achieving an undefeated Triple Crown, followed by countless accolades—the more the world demands a champion in Rudolf, the stronger she becomes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf was simply that kind of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So you have to run too, Ace!
I don't want to do it without you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Today was genuinely so much fun.
Running right next to you when you're like an absolute demon.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I want you there too.
Let's run through that grand stage together, the three of us.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: No good?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I-It's... not hopeless!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's not hopeless! And besides...!
Starting today, I'm gonna smash every single expectation riding on your shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wash your neck and wait for me, C.B.!
Don't just keep your eyes on Rudoooolph!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, what are you talking about, Ace?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I learned today, more than I ever
wanted to, just what you're capable of.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Our next target race is the Arima Kinen.
The grand year-end stage at Nakayama...!
